name: CAMI Benchmarking Portal
description: An online portal for evaluating, ranking, and comparing metagenomic software using standardized CAMI datasets and metrics.
evaluation_method: F1 / precision-recall and other task-specific metrics (ARI, L1 abundance error)
general_score_metric: F1 (for classification tasks) / L1 abundance error or ARI for profiling/binning tasks
reputation: Well-established and widely used in the metagenomics community for standardized comparison of tools.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark using synthetic and real metagenomic datasets; results are task-specific and sensitive to reference databases, contamination, and parameter choices; computationally and memory intensive to run full evaluations.
